open_work: Eight immutable source boxes become two empty wall cases and one window stand. Case rectangles and 1.45m tops remain; feet extend to the actual .01m floor. Thin 4mm side panes and a 5mm glass top replace solid glass and brass blocks. The top retains its outer brass rim at the original datum. Original source records stay unchanged. The east case and its top shorten by .15m at the rear (+X) end to clear the unchanged safe by .04m; the west case remains its full source length.

The source window has no itemized stock. Three unbranded passive arrangements are a declared visual adaptation, not original inventory: a collapsed brass telescope on two cradles, a pocket watch and laid chain on a supported upright cushion, and paired field-glass barrels on a fitted cradle. No inscriptions, new purchasable stock, optical gameplay, clock-time authority or signal technology.

The window deck rises .20m to .64m so stock is above the existing .55m sill. Six feet carry the full retained footprint and backboard. New stock is physically seated on the deck and fits below the original 1.57m board top. The empty wall cases keep their original roles; no treasure or pledge item is invented inside them.

Local catalogue walnut and aged brass replace the coarse original surfaces without changing shared materials. All bitmap maps already exist. Pledge stock, grille/counter, safe, balance, ledger, loupe, services, continuous routes and human acceptance remain open.

Scoped optical adaptation: the two display cases, paired field-glass lenses and remaining original fixed shop glazing use the existing architectural clear dielectric shader at its .06 roughness. Underlying mapped source materials, original fixed mesh, transform and collision remain. No global glass or lighting settings change.
